envelope_matching.bare_hunk: first match at/after current forward cursor, not uniqueness
envelope_matching.cursor: after replacement in mutated in-memory line vector
envelope_matching.anchor: first trim_end exact at/after cursor; fallback first trim match; then search after anchor
envelope_matching.eof: pattern must match exactly at file end, at/after cursor
envelope_matching.pure_insertion: requires anchor, EOF marker, or empty file
envelope_matching.numeric_header: range numbers ignored; trailing anchor retained
envelope_matching.newline: preserves original trailing LF presence; lines split and rejoined with LF

atomicity: Parsing/planning/context failures write nothing for entire envelope. Actual postvalidation filesystem failures may partially apply and report applied sections/partial paths.
